title: Pillow begins operating
description: Pillow began offering a custodial crypto savings and yield application.
notes: Launch date is approximate and recorded at year-level.

title: Pillow announces orderly shutdown
description: Pillow told users that it would discontinue services because regulatory uncertainty made continued operation difficult and instructed users to withdraw their funds.
notes: Interest accrual stopped immediately; bank and crypto withdrawal windows remained open for limited periods.

title: Pillow services end
description: Pillow's announced crypto-withdrawal and service-closure deadline arrived on 31 July 2023.
notes: The deadline is supported by contemporaneous reproductions of Pillow's customer notice.

title: Nuri launches Bitcoin Interest Account
description: Nuri, formerly Bitwala, launched a Bitcoin interest product brokered through its app and provided by Celsius Network.
notes: Launch date is recorded at month-level.

title: Nuri interest-account withdrawals pause
description: After Celsius paused withdrawals, Nuri stated that withdrawals from its Bitcoin Interest Account were unavailable and paused new investments in the product.
notes: Ordinary Nuri banking, custody-wallet and vault products were not the same product and are not classified by this event.

title: Celsius files Chapter 11
description: Celsius Network and related debtors filed Chapter 11, moving the underlying Nuri Bitcoin Interest Account exposure into the Celsius claims process.
notes: Nuri customers used a product brokered by Nuri but provided contractually by Celsius.

title: Nuri files for insolvency
description: Nuri filed for insolvency in Germany after market stress and the failure of its Celsius partnership worsened its financial position.
notes: Nuri stated that ordinary customer bank and custody assets were not affected in the same way as the Bitcoin Interest Account.

title: Nuri discontinues services
description: Nuri ended its business operations after failing to secure an investor or acquirer and instructed ordinary customers to withdraw or transfer their assets.
notes: The shutdown of Nuri's ordinary services did not resolve the separate Celsius-linked interest-account claims.

title: Celsius plan becomes effective and distributions begin
description: The Celsius reorganization plan became effective and distributions to eligible creditors began through approved distribution partners.
notes: Distributions are individualized and continued through later rounds; this is not recorded as completed repayment for every former Nuri interest-account user.
